onset.Description: Onset time of the PLD, in seconds.

trial_type.Description: The type of stimulus presented. Corresponds to 'stimtype'.

response_time.Description: Reaction time from stimulus onset to button press.

trial_no.Description: Sequential trial number within the run.

biomotion.Description: The type of motion. Corresponds to 'biomotion'.

Levels.0: EDIT ME: e.g., No biological motion.
Levels.2: EDIT ME: e.g., Biological motion present.
